content: [Slack #dba-alerts monitoring-bot Mon Jan 13 08:00 EST 2026] ALERT: Query execution time P95 exceeded 5000ms on finedge_prod. Affected queries: 1001, 1003, 1005. DB load avg: 14.2 (threshold: 8.0). Immediate investigation required.

Alert acknowledged. I will pull the pg_stat_statements snapshot and identify the top offending queries. Initial triage: queryid 1003 (COUNT on events) and 1001 (events service_id filter) are the most likely culprits based on mean_exec_time > 10,000ms.
[Slack #dba-alerts li-wei Mon Jan 13 08:15 EST 2026] @team I'm starting the slow query investigation. Pulling pg_stat_statements snapshot now. Will post top-5 in a few minutes.
Confirmed — starting analysis. The pgstatstatements_snapshot.csv contains the full 61-column snapshot. Will identify top-5 by mean_exec_time and share queryids with query text.

[Slack #dba-alerts maya-lin Mon Jan 13 09:00 EST 2026] Li Wei, please also check if any cross-table JOIN queries are doing Merge Joins that could benefit from Hash Join + statistics. We had a similar issue on the Render stack — 90M row events table JOINed with a smaller table caused 79M unnecessary row scans. (Reference: render.com/blog/postgresql-slow-query-to-fast-via-stats)

Noted. I will check Query-002 (orders JOIN users via service_id) specifically for Merge Join pathology. The Render case involved CREATE STATISTICS on a JSON column — I'll investigate whether our events.service_id has similar statistics gaps.

[Slack #dba-alerts alex-reeves Mon Jan 13 10:30 EST 2026] This is unacceptable. Finance dashboard is timing out. Li Wei, I need a full optimization done by end of week. Top priority. Loop in Sreedhar if you need help.
Priority escalation noted. CTO requires optimization complete by end of week. Looping in Sreedhar via DM for index design advice.
